page.intro_html: Fatigued by our hyperactive visual culture, Craig was moved to start making laconic, zero-budget experimental films, guided by the slogan ‘the slow and the spurious, not the fast and the furious’.
page.seo_desc: The films of C. M. Taylor, made under the name Slow and Spurious Films – award-winning, zero-budget experimental short films.

films.title: Le Jazz
films.logline: Can you make good art from bad?
films.desc: A zero-budget film named after a painting bought for €50 off the wall of a restaurant on the Costa Blanca in Spain twenty years ago. A new work of art is created from the painting during the film.

films.title: The Library of Unwritten Books
films.logline: A writer discovers a library in his home, stocked with all the books he never managed to write.
films.desc: A work of spiritual allegory inspired by Jung, Blake and Borges. Zero budget, comprising four long, handheld shots.

films.title: The Other Side of Boredom
films.logline: There is a world of rapture on the other side of boredom.
films.desc: A single-shot film documenting an unremarkable morning jog becomes a history of our species and a touching personal skirmish with the truth of ageing. A single-shot, zero-budget experimental documentary by a 53-year-old first-time film maker. Go figure.
